Free prototype

Dressmaker Demo and Free Download

The free Dressmaker demo is the prototype on the developers' own itch.io page: elyaradine.itch.io/dressmaker. It is name your own price, so you can take it for $0, and it runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. It is the only official free download that exists.

Reviewed September 21, 2026

  • PriceFree, name your own price
  • Whereitch.io, the developers’ own page
  • PlatformsWindows, macOS and Linux
  • DownloadAbout 115–128 MB
  • VersionPrototype 0.5.5
  • Rating4.8 of 5 from 834 ratings

The Dressmaker demo is a free prototype on itch.io — name your own price, Windows, macOS and Linux, about 115–128 MB. It is a standalone 2025 prototype, not a Steam demo of the full game.

Free prototype or full game?

Two different downloads, and it matters which one you want.

Where the free Dressmaker download is

The only official free download is the developers' own page: elyaradine.itch.io/dressmaker. elyaradine is Jonathan Hau-Yoon, one of the three developers, so it is first-party.

The listing is name your own price: clicking Download Now opens the Dressmaker download page, where the price field accepts $0. The current build is version 0.5.5.

PlatformFileSize
WindowsDressmaker Prototype Windows 0.5.5.zip115 MB
LinuxDressmaker Prototype Linux 0.5.5.zip127 MB
macOSDressmaker Prototype OSX 0.5.5.zip128 MB

Note

there is no playable browser version and no released mobile or APK version of Dressmaker. Mobile ports are only something the developers said they are planning. Anything offering either today is unofficial.

The macOS warning, and the official fix

Warning

the macOS build is not notarized, because the team has no Apple developer account. macOS refuses to open it and warns that it may be malicious.

The developers publish their own workaround on the itch page.

  1. 1

    Open System Settings

    from the Apple menu.

  2. 2

    Go to Privacy & Security

    .

  3. 3

    Scroll to the security section

    macOS lists the blocked app there. Click Open Anyway.

  4. 4

    Confirm the choice

    in the second prompt.

Note

this is the route the itch page documents. You only need to do it once.

What is actually in the prototype

The prototype is the project the full game grew out of: a Free Lives project made in about three weeks, plus another month or two of work.

In prototype 0.5.5Not in prototype 0.5.5
Take a commission, choose fabric, cut the pattern, sew, decorate, hand inA cut-down slice of the Steam release
The 2025 itch.io project, still labelled "Prototype"The content-complete September 2026 launch build
Free, on Windows, macOS and LinuxAchievements, an ending, Steam Cloud, the town of clients
"A lot of unfinished seams", per the developersThe full wardrobe of dress pieces, fabrics and accessories

It is not a Steam demo

No. It is the original standalone prototype at version 0.5.5, and it is not a cut-down slice of the September 2026 Steam release. The two are separate downloads. The Dressmaker sewing tips page explains grain and bias.

Who should download it, and who should skip it

Four reasons to grab it, and one to skip it.

  • You want a free test drive

    Cutting, layout and sewing for $0, before you spend $14.99.

  • You play on Linux

    Steam has no Linux depot, so this is the only build for you.

  • You like unfinished builds

    Unfinished seams included, exactly as the developers describe it.

  • Skip it for the story

    The town of clients, the achievements and the ending live in the paid release.

The only thing you risk is an evening. The Dressmaker guide to how to play walks the same steps in the finished game, and the dressmaker game overview has the price and the customer briefs.

Is the full game free?

No. Asked in the itch.io comments before launch, developer elyaradine answered: "No, the full [game will not be free]."

The Steam release is $14.99, or $13.49 with the 10% launch discount, with no microtransactions and no ads. The Dressmaker Steam release date page has the bundles.

Questions people ask before downloading

Is the Dressmaker prototype free?

Yes. The prototype on itch.io is name your own price, so you can download it for $0 or pay whatever you think it is worth. The paid Steam release is a separate, much bigger game.

Is the itch.io prototype a Steam demo?

No. It is the original standalone prototype at version 0.5.5, and it is not a cut-down slice of the September 2026 Steam release. The two are separate downloads.

Is there a browser version or a Dressmaker APK?

Not today. There is no playable browser version and no released mobile or APK version of Dressmaker. The developers said at launch that mobile ports are being planned, so watch their official channels. Anything offering either right now is unofficial.

Do I need a gaming PC to run the prototype?

The developers have not published system requirements for the itch prototype. For the full game, Steam lists minimum specifications only, with no recommended tier. The Dressmaker system requirements page has both tables.

Is the prototype still being updated?

The current download is version 0.5.5, and the developers have not published a roadmap for further prototype updates. The "coming soon" content in the September devlog is for the full game.

What if it will not launch?

Start with Dressmaker troubleshooting. On macOS the notarization warning is expected. The team also links its Discord from the itch page.
